77th Cannes, 14 to 25 May 2024. I went for six days, 17 to 22 May, on a Cannes Cinéphiles pass (badge CC-24-08815), which gets you into the side sections and the leftover Competition repeats, not the red carpet. Applied as programmer for the Strathbungo Film Society. Took a week off sessions, lost about £900 in work. Worth it.

## Getting there and staying

- easyJet Glasgow to Nice, EZY-6941, 17 May 06:15, back on the 22nd. Hand luggage only, packed off [[Packing list carry-on]], which was right, the hand luggage queue at Nice took 10 minutes and the bag belt took Ishbel 50 the year before.
- Flat in Antibes, €95 a night, five nights. Train to Cannes 12 minutes, €3.40 each way. Last train back 23:10, which rules out the midnight screenings unless you want a €60 taxi.
- One hour time difference, no jet lag worth the name. Travel insurance through the policy I compared in [[Travel insurance comparison]].

## How the Cinéphiles pass works

Queue at the Cinéma de la Plage and Salle Agnès Varda for side bars and repeats. Tickets for Competition repeats through the app at 07:00 the day before, gone by 07:02. Got four out of nine I tried. Badge photo makes me look like a bus driver arrested for something.

## What I saw

### "Anora" (Sean Baker)

Saw it on 22 May, the repeat. The Brighton Beach stripper and the oligarch's son, the second half a farce with two hapless heavies. Laughed more than at anything in years. Didn't think it would win. It won the Palme d'Or on the 25th.

### "All We Imagine as Light" (Payal Kapadia)

Mumbai nurses, monsoon, quiet. Grand Prix. The last 20 minutes by the sea are as good as anything in the festival. Must show at the club, and it'll pair well with the Bollywood night, see [[बॉलीवुड क्लासिक्स]].

### "The Substance" (Coralie Fargeat)

Demi Moore. Body horror, gleeful, absurdly long final act, the audience at the Debussy whooped at the end. Best screenplay award. Will go in the 2025 horror night.

### "Megalopolis" (Francis Ford Coppola)

A man in the audience was invited onto the stage to ask Adam Driver a question during the film. That was the high point. Two and a quarter hours, I can't tell you what it's about.

### "Kinds of Kindness" (Yorgos Lanthimos)

Three stories, same cast. Jesse Plemons won best actor. Divided the room. I liked the first story, not the other two.

## Food and money

- Lunch at the Marché Forville, socca for €4. Dinner from the supermarket most nights.
- Total: flights £168, flat €475, trains €41, food about €190, pass free.

## Lessons

- The 07:00 ticket drop is everything. Set two alarms.
- Bring a jacket, the Debussy is freezing.
- The Cinéma de la Plage on the beach at night is the best seat in Cannes and it's free.

## For the club

Shortlist for the 2025 programme: "All We Imagine as Light", "The Substance" (horror night), "Anora" (licence too dear till it hits Filmbank). Predictions spillover in [[Oscar predictions]].
